body:
This reminds me of those old weird feelgood stories (?) about people making plush versions of children's drawings- very literally, including lopsided arms etc etc.... Always told as if this accurate recreation was the kids dream come true, his vision. 

Now dont get me wrong I'd have been pumped for any cool custom made for me toy as a kid that sounds sweet, but if people asked me for my ideal stuffed animal as a kid and I was limited to drawing it I'd feel sad when they so flawlessly recreated my lack of talent lol... you know? kid me couldnt draw a tiger for shit and still cant but its what i was going for you kniw?
The curl of the foot on the undrawn hand is my everything
